description: Team SYBAU is a solo mission. I am a Computer Engineering student specializing in web development, system architecture, and UI/UX dashboards. I will be tackling the 'Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer' using a custom HTML/CSS/JS state machine to simulate the chaotic resource management of a Martian outpost. Currently not accepting new crew members for this flight
summary: Red Planet Protocol is an interactive Martian habitat survival simulation and junior astronaut trainer designed for players aged 7–12. It challenges players with real-world space telemetry, emergency resource allocation, and scientific station management. By combining high-stakes survival mechanics—such as managing cascading fires, power grid overloads, and freezing Martian nights—with fully traceable STEM education, players navigate dynamic station emergencies while exploring authentic space science integrated directly into core gameplay loops.
details: The game operates on a 15-Sol narrative loop scaled to 1 Earth second per Martian hour. Players manage an interactive drag-and-drop 'Power Core' system to distribute energy across four station rooms (Life Support, Greenhouse, Shield Generator, Science Lab). Mechanics include managing cascading room fires, 4-Core Overload Marsquakes, and freezing night cycles that double resource drain. Every room features dynamic, randomized mini-tasks (e.g., 'Patch O2 Leak') carrying unique risks and rewards. The game evaluates player performance at Sol 15 with an S-to-F tier Mission Report Card.
